name: sing-box Link Manager
description:
Connect to a sing-box server straight from Quick Settings: import connections from a share link, a subscription URL, or a QR code image, then pick a server from the menu. Subscriptions are cached, so connecting never waits on the network.

Requires sing-box to be installed and allowed to create a TUN device, for example with: sudo setcap cap_net_admin,cap_net_raw+ep "$(command -v sing-box)". Without that one-time step the backend cannot start. See the project page for the optional polkit rule that also removes the password prompts systemd-resolved would otherwise raise on every connect.
